meta.title: Privacy Policy | MKR Caucasian Camp
meta.description: Privacy policy of MKR Caucasian Camp. Collection, use, and protection of your personal data.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: MKR Caucasian Camp is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

data_collected.title: Data collected
data_collected.intro: We collect the following data via our forms:
items: Last name, first name, date of birth
Sports information (discipline, level, experience, club, achievements, video link if provided)
Health information relevant to sports practice (conditions, injuries, contraindications)
Logistical preferences (registration tunnel, session, duration, desired dates)
Family or group composition where applicable (e.g., age of children for the family tunnel)
data_collected.metadata_intro_prefix: When the registration form is submitted, we also record two technical metadata items for security purposes (automation detection, anti-spam, forensic traceability in case of incident):
data_collected.metadata_ip_prefix: The IP address of the request (extracted from the
data_collected.metadata_outro: These two metadata items are stored with your application and kept under the same conditions and for the same duration as the other form data (see Retention section).

usage.title: Use of data
usage.intro: Your data is used exclusively to:
items: Contact you as part of the registration process
Prepare your stay (logistical and medical information)
Send you information about upcoming sessions (with your consent)
Detect automated submissions and prevent form abuse (IP and User-Agent only)

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Your data is kept for the time needed to process your application, and at most 3 years after your last contact with MKR Caucasian Camp. After this period, it is deleted from our database. You can request early deletion at any time (see Your rights).

subcontractors.title: Hosting and subcontractors
subcontractors.intro: To operate the registration form and the internal dashboard, we rely on the following subcontractors:

supabase.body_prefix: (Supabase, Inc., United States): hosting of the PostgreSQL database of applications. Our data is stored on European infrastructure (region
supabase.body_middle: , Frankfurt, Germany). Any transfers to the United States are governed by the European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC). Policy:

vercel.body_prefix: (Vercel, Inc., United States): hosting of the web application and server routes. Policy:

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: Your data is never sold to third parties. It may be shared with our logistical partners (on-site accommodation, transport) strictly within the framework of organizing your stay.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access to your data
rights.outro_prefix: To exercise these rights, write to us via the

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: This site uses one functional attribution cookie:
cookies.mkr_ref_body: functional referral attribution cookie. Stores the code of the partner who referred you to MKR (duration 90 days). No personal data, no third-party advertising tracking.

security.title: Security
security.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against any unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction.
